author: TrentonBricken
text:
SF folks, any ideas for how to figure out who owns this security camera at the intersection of 2nd Street and Harrison? 

It recorded a serious accident and is likely to auto-delete the footage soon. 

The police don’t know, SF MTA says it isn’t theirs, EastCut and YB neither… https://t.co/nYxfODozWr

author: TrentonBricken
text:
This is a nice example of how our feature clamping is different from using a system prompt or fine tuning. 

The feature is clamped at every token. This makes it always present and top of mind  — independent of new context being sampled. 

More details: https://t.co/pjkfORSxBh
